entry.title: Microsoft Says New Laptop With Nvidia Chip Outperforms MacBooks
entry.summary: Microsoft Corp. revealed pricing and availability for a new flagship laptop built on Nvidia Corp. chips, saying that the machine outperforms a comparable Apple Inc. model on some AI tasks.

entry.title: Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size
entry.summary: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open model with 740 million parameters that converts text, images, video, audio, and code into vectors. It runs on-device, needs only about 191 MB of RAM, and outperforms some competing models twice its size, according to Google.
